statements.criteria_for_short_course: The page gives no explicit criteria for a shorter course. It only says the number of sessions and the length of the treatment period depend on the treatment target, the goal of treatment and the choice of technique, and that the final duration is determined during planning.
statements.quote_fi: Sädehoitojakson pituus vaihtelee 1–4 viikkoon. Lopullinen hoidon kesto selviää suunnitelman teon yhteydessä.
statements.quote_en: The length of the radiotherapy course varies from 1 to 4 weeks. The final duration of treatment is determined when the plan is made.
